scripts.dev: npm exec concurrently -- --kill-others-on-fail --names main,blog,labs --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,green "node scripts/astro.mjs main dev --force --port 4321" "C:\Ruby34-x64\bin\jekyll.bat serve --source apps/blog --destination apps/blog/_site --livereload --port 4000" "node scripts/astro.mjs labs dev --ignore-lock --host labs.localhost --port 4322"
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:labs
scripts.deploy:main: npm run build:main && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.main.jsonc
scripts.deploy:labs: npm run build:labs && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.labs.jsonc
scripts.check: node scripts/astro.mjs main check && node scripts/astro.mjs labs check
